title: Retirement plan correction (IRS VCP submission): documents needed from the plan sponsor
use_when: Use when a plan sponsor is filing a Voluntary Correction Program (VCP) submission with the IRS on Form 8950 to correct a retirement plan failure.
note: Built from Rev. Proc. 2021-30 (EPCRS) sections 11.04 and 11.11, the Instructions for Form 8950 (Rev. January 2022) and the IRS page on VCP submission documents. It does not decide which failures exist, whether self-correction (SCP) is available, the correction method, or the user fee amount, and it does not cover Department of Labor programs.

rp-2021-30.name: IRS, Rev. Proc. 2021-30, Employee Plans Compliance Resolution System (2021-31 I.R.B. 172)

i8950.name: IRS, Instructions for Form 8950, Application for Voluntary Correction Program (VCP) (Rev. January 2022)

irs-vcp-docs.name: IRS, Correcting plan errors - fill in VCP submission documents (page last reviewed or updated 13-Nov-2026)

situations.representative: Will the firm or another representative sign and file the submission for the plan sponsor?
situations.copies-to-other: Should IRS correspondence also be mailed to someone other than the sponsor or its representative?
situations.preapproved-doc-failure: Is the submission limited to plan document failures for a pre-approved plan that uses an adoption agreement?
situations.sep-simple: Is the plan a SEP or SIMPLE IRA plan?
situations.plan-loans: Do the failures involve participant loans?
situations.excise-relief: Is the sponsor asking for relief from excise taxes (sections 4972, 4973, 4974 or 4979) or the 10% additional tax under section 72(t)?
situations.transferred-assets: Did a failure relate to assets transferred from another plan before the transfer?
situations.orphan-plan: Is this an orphan plan whose sponsor no longer exists, cannot be located, or cannot maintain the plan?
situations.has-irs-letter: Does the plan have an IRS opinion, advisory or determination letter?
situations.adp-failure: Is one of the failures an ADP test failure?

items.label: Plan sponsor's name, address, phone and fax number as shown on the latest Form 5500
items.detail: Form 8950 lines 1a–1k. Should be the same information used on the filed Form 5500, 5500-SF or 5500-EZ.

items.label: Plan sponsor's EIN (the one used on Form 5500), not an SSN or trust EIN
items.detail: Form 8950 instructions. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Most recently filed Form 5500 series return for the plan
items.detail: Form 8950 line 1l: the six-digit business code can be copied from it.

items.label: Copy of the entire plan document, or the relevant portions
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(8). Relevant portions include the provisions tied to the failure (for example eligibility, allocation and cash or deferred provisions, the adoption agreement if any, and applicable definitions).

items.label: Signed and dated adoption agreement for the pre-approved plan
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(8): for submissions limited to plan document failures under a pre-approved plan, this is all that is needed instead of the entire plan document.

items.label: The entire SEP or SIMPLE IRA plan document
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(8).

items.label: Copy of the plan's IRS opinion, advisory or determination letter
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.11(8).

items.label: Description of each failure, the years it happened (including closed years), and the number of employees affected
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(1).

items.label: Explanation of how and why the failures happened, and the administrative procedures in place at the time
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(2).

items.label: Information to support the correction: employees affected, expected cost of correction, years involved, and the calculations or assumptions used
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(3). Numbers may be approximated if the exact figure is not known at the time of the request.

items.label: Data needed for calculations for each affected employee, or a representative sample
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(5): sample calculations must demonstrate each aspect of the correction method, plus the earnings or actuarial adjustment method under section 11.04(4). Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: ADP test results before and after correction
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(5) example.

items.label: How former employees and beneficiaries will be located and notified, or confirmation that none were affected
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(6).

items.label: Description of the procedures put in place so the failures do not happen again
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(7).

items.label: Decision on whether to ask that corrected participant loans not be treated as deemed distributions (or be reported in the year of correction)
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(10). Form 14568-E (Schedule 5) covers plan loan failures.

items.label: Facts supporting the request for excise tax or additional tax relief
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(9).

items.label: Description of the transaction, including the dates of the employer change and the plan transfer
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(11).

items.label: Statement that all other entities involved with the plan were contacted and will cooperate, and the type of employer
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(12), for example confirming cooperation from the insurance company or custodian holding plan assets.

items.label: Penalty of perjury declaration signed and dated by the plan sponsor
items.detail: Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(16) and Form 8950 instructions. Required when a representative signs and files; it cannot be signed by the sponsor's representative.

items.label: Signed Form 2848, Power of Attorney, with the VCP wording on lines 3 and 5a
items.detail: Form 8950 instructions: line 3 description "Voluntary Correction Program submission per Rev. Proc. 2021-30", Tax Form Number 8950; line 5a other acts "The signing and filing of the Form 8950 and accompanying documents as part of a VCP submission". Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Signed Form 8821, Tax Information Authorization, for the person to receive copies of IRS correspondence
items.detail: Form 8950 line 2a instructions. The person on Form 8821 is not a representative. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Court order or other documents showing the applicant is an eligible party for the orphan plan
items.detail: Form 8950 instructions and Rev. Proc. 2021-30 section 11.04(14), with a letter stating the submission concerns an orphan plan.

sections.name: Model forms the firm may prepare

items.label: Information for Form 14568, Model VCP Compliance Statement, and any applicable schedules (Forms 14568-A through 14568-I)
items.detail: The IRS page encourages the model forms and says not to modify their format and content; schedules cover, for example, 403(b) document failures, nonamender failures, SEPs, SIMPLE IRAs, plan loans, employer eligibility, excess deferrals, late required minimum distributions and plan amendment corrections.
